subgraphs.name: Dials - H3 + De-rope
subgraphs.description: MiniMax H3 text/image to video with the Dial Rack on the model input. Wire the Render Preset into sampler, sigmas, de-rope steps and conditioning. de-rope: off renders one pass; oracle slows only the jerky stretches, flat slows every frame by max de-rope; both map the clip back to real time. de-rope amount is how much of stage 2 is re-rendered (0.48 faithful). pass 2 audio off keeps pass 1's audio. Gives the final clip with its audio as VIDEO: wire it to Save Video (or an upscaler first). Double-click to open the graph.

widgets_values: use pass 2's foley - ONLY IF the audio rows were seeded

video: pass 1, or the de-roped clip

De-rope 2: same rack + hold map, stage-2 sigmas from de-rope amount
